verdicts.details: Four independent `base == ""` decisions sit at comment.go:30 (link), 100 (pairGrid), 131 (shotGrid) and 150 (tabs), each handling the no-base case its own way, and `-base-url` defaults to "" in main.go, so the shape is what every local `gnopreview comment` emits. Coverage puts three of those blocks at zero hits and all six `Comment(` calls in plan_test.go pass "https://example.test/…", so the godoc promise that an empty baseURL "still lists what was rendered" is asserted nowhere. Rewriting link's empty-base branch to `return ""` deletes every realm bullet from the comment and `go test ./...` still answers ok. The finder's stated harm does not hold: the gnoweb branch does emit its realm bullets as code spans under an empty base, so the comment reads coherently today — what is absent is the test that keeps it so as the next helper is added. Fix: pin the no-base shape with judge-221-empty-base-url_test.go, which also asserts that no bullet or image carries a root-relative href GitHub would resolve against github.com.

verdicts.tldr: the realm bullet is spelled three ways and urlOf runs twice per realm; one realmItem carries all three, 196 -> 191 lines
verdicts.details: Lines 63 and 80 build a bullet as `link(urlOf(r), r) + tabs(base, r)`, and tabs at 153 calls `urlOf(pkgPath)` on the same argument again, so the link text and the tab targets are derived twice through separate expressions. Line 44 hand-builds a third spelling that omits the shortcuts, which is the drift already present. Nothing is wrong in the output today; the cost is that a change to urlOf or to the bullet has to be traced through three sites. Collapsing the 6-line link closure and the 8-line tabs into one 8-line realmItem leaves gofmt, vet and the suite silent. verdicts.verify_by: in a clone at ecf7af0f2, apply edit list A from the artifact header (drop the Dir field, drop `Dir: rel`, drop the byDir block, rewrite the two lookups), then cd misc/gnopreview && go test ./...
verdicts.tldr: Pkg.Dir is always "examples/"+Pkg.Path and byDir re-indexes a map that already answers; both go, 345 -> 337 lines
verdicts.details: LoadPkgs sets Path and Dir from one string at plan.go:138-139, `Path: strings.TrimPrefix(rel, examplesRel+"/")` and `Dir: rel`, and the walk is rooted at pkgRoot = "examples/gno.land", so Dir == "examples/"+Path for every package with no exception. BuildPlan then spends five lines at 199-201 building byDir to invert a map it already holds, and its two consumers reduce to direct lookups: byDir[path.Dir(f)] is pkgs[strings.TrimPrefix(path.Dir(f), examplesRel+"/")], and pkgs[r].Dir is examplesRel+"/"+r. The cost of keeping both is two fields that can disagree and a second index every later reader has to prove is in sync. Fix: apply edit list A — dropping the field also proves no caller outside plan.go reads it, since the package and its tests still compile.
verdicts.evidence: Applied edit list A in a detached worktree at ecf7af0f2 (5 replacements, each asserted unique): wc -l plan.go 345 -> 337; gofmt -l . silent; go vet ./... silent; 'ok  github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview  0.004s'. The compile itself is the reach check: removing `Dir` from the Pkg struct breaks nothing in the package or its tests.
